title: Parity report (default track vs stack track)

observability.description: key '<pillar>|<target>', field 'status'; stack 'warn' is mapped to 'pass' before comparing (the only allowed mapping)

traces.description: Normalized agent-trace spans keyed by path (agent.run/…/<name>#<campaign or ordinal>); fields: status, status_message, attributes, events. Ids and times are excluded.

bronze.description: Bronze per table and batch: key '<table>|<batch_id>' (fields rows, checksum = bit_xor(hash(row))) plus '<table>|(colunas)' (fields rows = column count, checksum = ordered column list). The stack's Bronze arrives from the mock sources through dlt; the default track's from the generator.

ingestion.description: Stack only: one item per source load; a diff is any status other than carregado/sem_dados_novos (key = fonte, field status, stack_track = 'status: motivo').

policy.description: Phase 4 US3: policy checks per proposed action (both evaluators) and the casos.yaml matrix through LocalEvaluator and OPA.

ok.description: true only if every comparison has zero diffs

description: 2.2.0 (Phase 4): adds compared.bronze and compared.ingestion (and compared.policy from US3). Additive over 2.1.0.
